quotes.text: All data used in this study were synthetically generated.
This research does not require IRB approval.
This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

parsed.rationale: Origin (synthetic data plus NHS-crawled disease-symptom pairs), collection method (web crawling, LLM post-processing, manual labelling), an explicit statement that IRB approval is not required, and a repo licence are all documented. The terms of the NHS source content are not stated and the Apache licence covers the project, which is noted without lowering the score.
